newsitem.title: UK: GAFTA sees need for more effective lobbying of EU.
newsitem.headline: GAFTA sees need for more effective lobbying of EU.

text.p: The grain trade needs more effective mechanisms for lobbying European Union institutions, according to David Small, president of the Grain and Feed Trade Association (GAFTA).

A less fragmented approach to lobbying the European Commission could do much to further the cause of the grain trade, Small said, speaking at a reception following GAFTA's annual general meeting on Thursday.

"I believe that agricultural representation to the EU Commission could be improved," Small said. GAFTA had found it necessary to review its representation in Brussels via Coceral, the EU grain trade organisation, Small said.
Small, of the Southern Counties Agricultural Trading Society, was re-elected as president of the association by a GAFTA council meeting after Thursday's AGM.
